checks.name: Coilblade
checks.lore: A clockwork duelist was assembled from a cracked kiln bell and copper from the old riverworks. At dusk, its blade catches the forge light like a thin line of sunrise.

checks.name: Mossguard
checks.lore: This grove keeper wears a shield cut from an old bough, with leaves pressed into the grain. Each leaf marks a trail the woodland guides promised to keep clear.

checks.name: Copperskiff
checks.lore: The little airship began as a copper kettle patched into a hull beside the mill. Its canvas sail still carries the scent of river rain.

checks.name: Skymaul
checks.lore: A stone wanderer drifted down from the cloud shelf, carrying a hammer left behind by the first valley smith. Copper bands around its arms keep little chips of rock from tumbling loose.

checks.name: Brassbolt
checks.lore: The ranger made a crossbow from a brass hinge and a piece of bell metal. Amber fletching on each bolt points home to the lanterns of the foundry.

checks.name: Reedsting
checks.lore: A marsh pathfinder ties reeds into a hood and the cords of each arrow. Small stitched marks on the lining count every crossing through the river grass.

checks.name: Briar Band
checks.lore: The runners and darters met in a thorn maze and chose the same leaf mark for their masks. They leave chalk arrows on the stumps so the next scout can find the way out.

checks.name: Cinderlings
checks.lore: Three ember sprouts woke beneath a fallen lantern in a bed of ash. They gather sparks in nutshell caps and leave tiny lights along the stones.

checks.name: Brackenwheel
checks.lore: Brackenwheel learned to clear jammed sluice gates by spinning a copperroot sickle through the reeds. After dusk, emberseed sparks trace a ring around her boots, and she counts each flicker as a warning from the river.

checks.name: Stonehauler
checks.lore: This broad pack carrier is built around a core of quarry stone, wrapped in weathered rootwood. Copper bells on its straps ring out when it reaches the river workshops.

checks.name: Thornscouts
checks.lore: The four Thornscouts mark safe crossings with tiny cuts in their light blades. Pale leaf masks turn their faces into a blur among the fern paths.

checks.name: Forgeguard
checks.lore: Five Forgeguard keep the river workshops supplied with hammers and axes. Their copper aprons darken at the seams, but each hammer tap keeps the old bridge pins true.

checks.name: Cinder Host
checks.lore: Fifteen ember sprouts gathered in the ash beds when the Rivermark kiln first cooled for winter. At dawn, their scorched nutshell caps made a bright trail from the woodpile to the workshop door.

checks.name: Ironroot
checks.lore: The oak beside Emberfall’s old foundry split when an ironstone seam surfaced through its roots. Rivermark smiths bound its crooked trunk with hammered copper and cut a broad blade from the dark seam.

checks.name: Sunthread Pair
checks.lore: When emberseed lights began appearing above the Rivermark root bridges, two woodland wardens braided copper thread through their yew bows so travelers could follow each safe trail. At dusk, the Sunthread Pair trade watch from the amber-lit fern paths and send warning arrows toward any lantern lost in the trees.

checks.name: Duskwing Trio
checks.lore: Three owl-moths hatched from a reed basket warmed beside an emberseed stove at the Emberfall river workshop. Each twilight they carry the seed’s tiny glow through the fern hollows, guiding Rivermark ferrymakers home above the water.

checks.name: Gloamwing Cluster
checks.lore: Gloamwings rise from the violet reeds at dusk to follow emberseeds down the riverbank. Five of them wheel around each warm spark until ferry bells call them home.

checks.name: Coppershade Flock
checks.lore: Coppershades roost in the offcuts piled outside the Rivermark river workshop. When the kiln wakes, all six glide over the canal and trade tiny sparks above their copper-lit nests.

checks.name: Kilnkeeper
checks.lore: Kilnkeeper tends the warm river kilns where rootwood beams are steamed and copper vessels are shaped, keeping each emberseed dry between shifts. When raiders threaten the workshop, he loads one emberseed into his broad-mouthed launcher and sends a single burst of sparks skittering across the ground.

checks.name: Squall Orb
checks.lore: Rivermark glassblowers formed the Squall Orb from stormglass swept downstream after a spring squall. Its copper collar rests on the foundry shelf, where apprentices mark the days they carried its bright shards through the rain.

checks.name: Ember Basin
checks.lore: The Ember Basin stands where the creek turns, its copper lip warmed by emberseeds carried down from the Moss & Ember workshop. At dusk, twin braces hold its long copper-ribbed launch channel above the water, ready to turn any unwelcome visitor away.

checks.name: Buried Coil
checks.lore: At the alderwood river workshop, Ilyra winds a young emberseed into a copper coil and seals it beneath a hatch beside the sluice. When raider boots shake the roots, the seed glows and the hatch lifts a riveted lookout to guard the waterwheel.

checks.name: Aether Well
checks.lore: At dusk, the Aether Well’s copper scoop gathers glowing emberseed from the quiet river water. Workshop keepers wind its rootwood crank to lift the seeds into stoppered flasks for the nearby repair shed.
